roteiros.titulo: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
roteiros.prompt:
HOOK: [Pexels: planet Earth rotating space] What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: equator aerial view] At the equator, Earth's surface moves at 1,670 kilometers per hour.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: ocean waves crashing] If Earth stopped instantly, the atmosphere and oceans would keep moving.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: deep space Earth zoom out] The consequences would be catastrophic... as Earth pulls away into deep space.
roteiros.voiceover_script: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning? At the equator, Earth's surface moves at 1,670 kilometers per hour. If Earth stopped instantly, the atmosphere and oceans would keep moving. The consequences would be catastrophic... as Earth pulls away into deep space.
scenes: planet Earth rotating space, equator aerial view
enviado: A close-up shot of the Earth from space, showing the equator and rotating rapidly, then suddenly stopping, emphasizing the equator line clearly.
A drone shot capturing the curvature of the Earth at the equator, zooming in to highlight the dynamic movement of clouds and land, emphasizing the high speed of 1,670 kilometers per hour.
A tracking shot along a rugged coastline where powerful ocean waves crash violently against rocks, symbolizing the relentless movement of the atmosphere and oceans if the Earth were to stop spinning.

enviado: A close-up shot of an enormous human hand gripping a regular-sized pen, highlighting the immense scale difference between the giant hand and the small object. The background is blurred to focus on the sheer size and power of the hand, creating an energetic visual punch.
